verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own docs list 'Enhanced mass deployment (MSI)', a first-party capability for acting on many devices at once. Remote script execution, automating recurring fixes and a Web API hint at fleet-wide actions, but none of these is documented as running bulk operations across many items. Missing for 10: documented bulk or multi-select operations across devices or items, bulk endpoints in the Web API, any detail beyond pricing-page bullets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
